questions.question: What is JavaScript?
questions.explanation: JavaScript is a programming language commonly used to make websites interactive.

questions.question: Which keyword creates a variable that can be reassigned?
questions.explanation: The let keyword creates a variable whose value can be changed later.

questions.question: Which method adds an item to the end of an array?
questions.explanation: push() adds one or more items to the end of an array.

questions.question: Which keyword declares a constant?
questions.explanation: const creates a variable binding that cannot be reassigned.

questions.question: Which symbol is used for strict equality?
questions.explanation: The === operator checks both value and data type.

questions.question: What is React?
questions.explanation: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces.

questions.question: Which hook is commonly used to manage state?
questions.explanation: useState allows a React component to store and update state.

questions.question: What is a React component?
questions.explanation: Components are reusable pieces of a React user interface.

questions.question: What is used to pass data from a parent to a child component?
questions.explanation: Props allow a parent component to pass data to a child component.

questions.question: Which hook is commonly used for side effects?
questions.explanation: useEffect is used to perform side effects such as API requests.

questions.question: Which HTML element creates a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: The anchor element <a> creates hyperlinks.

questions.question: Which element is used for the main heading?
questions.explanation: The h1 element represents the most important heading on a page.

questions.question: Which HTML element creates a form?
questions.explanation: The form element groups controls used to collect user input.

questions.question: Which element creates a numbered list?
questions.explanation: The ol element creates an ordered, numbered list.

questions.question: Which attribute provides alternative text for an image?
questions.explanation: The alt attribute provides alternative text for images.

questions.question: Which CSS property creates a flex container?
questions.explanation: display: flex turns an element into a flex container.

questions.question: Which CSS property changes text color?
questions.explanation: The color property controls the color of text.

questions.question: Which CSS property changes the background color?
questions.explanation: background-color sets the background color of an element.

questions.question: Which layout system is useful for two-dimensional layouts?
questions.explanation: CSS Grid is designed for two-dimensional row and column layouts.

questions.question: Which unit is relative to the root font size?
questions.explanation: The rem unit is relative to the root HTML element's font size.
